renewal_options: Salesforce releases three major updates per year. For each release, certified professionals must complete a free maintenance module on Trailhead to retain their certification. No cost for maintenance.
target_audience: Individuals from all backgrounds, including business leaders and professionals who may have knowledge of AI, whether they are beginners or individuals with more experience.
recommended_experience: Foundational knowledge of Salesforce's core capabilities and the ability to navigate Salesforce.
